sloka: सिद्धार्थ: खलु सौमित्रिर्यश्चन्द्रविमलोपमम्।मुखं पश्यति रामस्य राजीवाक्षं महाद्युति ॥ २.९८.१०॥
transliteration: siddhārtha: khalu saumitriryaścandravimalopamam।mukhaṁ paśyati rāmasya rājīvākṣaṁ mahādyuti ॥ 2.98.10॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, one who beholds the highly effulgent countenance of Rama, resembling the spotless Moon and whose eyes resemble red lotuses, is blessed indeed
